name: Mickey's Smokestack Jalapeño Cheese Cornbread, Baked Beans & Collard Greens (Avoid)
whyItWorks: Warning entry: unlike Pirate Night's plain Johnny Cake, the Smokestack cornbread has diced jalapeños and whole corn kernels, while baked beans and collard stems are high-residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the jalapeño cornbread, collard greens, coleslaw, and baked beans at the BBQ counter; choose Baked Mac & Cheese or a white bun instead.
watchOuts: Diced jalapeño peppers and whole corn kernels in cornbread
High insoluble fiber in collard greens and baked beans
